sentences.text: Streptococcus pneumoniae is a highly adapted commensal of its obligate human host, whose main reservoir is the mucosal surface of the upper airways of carriers.
In low and lower-middle income countries nasopharyngeal carriage is frequent, especially in children, and the range of serotypes carried is wide.
It is described as the most common cause of community-acquired pneumonia, meningitis and bacteraemia, with invasive disease mainly affecting young children, older adults and immunocompromised people.
